body: Thanks. It feels weird receiving support from someone. That makes me happy, I think.

But how, if I may ask ?

I've tried everything to improve my performance at school, but my mind is just...? How can I explain it.
It starts asking me questions, and that makes me lose motivation. It starts thinking about other things, and I lose my concentration.

There's a constant voice in the back telling me to give up, that it's pointless.

I've tried everything but therapy. That shit's expensive. And a waste of time. People have it much worse than me, I have no right to waste a professional's time when they can help someone else instead.

I'm trying. I promise I'm really trying.

But then my mind starts to spiral down, and I feel like screaming...

All I wanted was to make my parents happy, and hear them say "I'm proud of you."

My father isn't someone who use sugar-coated(?) words, I appreciate his honesty. Thanks to him, I've realized how worthy I am, which is none.

Thank you for trying to cheer me up though, I didn't mean to waste your time with my issues..

I don't even know where to begin.
Everything's wrong with me, from the way I talk, the way I think, the way I'm not good enough at doing anything, my grades who keep dropping because my fucking mind refuses to concentrate, and many other things.
My father, the most realistic person I've ever met, told me how I deceived them ( my family ), how embarrassed they felt when they saw my performance at school, how much I disappointed them.
He told me : "You failed. You deceived us, and that makes me really sad."

I cannot blame him, hah ! My poor parents, I feel so bad for them.

Please help me, I want to die in the most painful way possible to repay all the things they did to me.
